title: The Design system check runner loads in the tracy-web image, and a crashed check names its error on /ops
steps: S1: Scan every module under apps/tracy-web/src for a relative import that resolves outside the app.
S2: Rebuild the image layout (apps/tracy-web src + package.json, ds-slot src and templates under src/ds-slot) in a temporary folder and run both readiness check-runner.mjs on an empty folder.
S3: Give childErrorOf the stderr of a crashed child (stack, then 'Node.js v24.22.0').
expect: S2: each runner exits 2 with its own refusal; no ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
S3: the reason is the 'Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module ...' line, not the Node.js version.
evidence: dev /api/ops/quickstarts 16/10/2026 10:24Z: every release ds-error 'Node.js v24.22.0'; reproduced in an image-shaped folder
fence: tracy-web module graph and the readiness child process; no stand, no Postgres
